name: no re-measure of the navbar on a window resize
why: Known overlap: with the sticky filter bars on, _vsbBaseOffset() calls _slNavbarOffset() on every refresh, and a resize schedules one. The listener of _slPrepareLivePage() only matters with the bars switched off (the thead rule reads the variable), which no spec resizes.
grep: the list h2 docks under the site's navbar
